<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Initial review of the CantoMode scripts has begun. The first notable finding relates to LyricsDisplay.

Missing source files were found alongside their .meta metadata. SUDPReceiver.cs was unexpectedly excluded from the glob search despite being readable. The next step is verifying whether SingPublicSystem and ControladorAudienciaSing are present in the scene.

PianoPublicSystem removes ControladorAudiencia from the piano scene. A critical scoring bug was found: HitDetector registers hits every frame while notes are active, artificially inflating scores. Several methods are completely unused, including GetCurrentPublicScore and GetCurrentPublicScoreForApplause. StartGame and EndGame are never invoked, so isGameActive remains false and SingPublicSystem Update never executes.

ControladorAudiencia appears to be the actual component in the SingGame scene. Its presence depends on whether SingPublicSystem adds it at runtime. The exact components assigned to the SingGame scene still need verification.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The full CantoMode script structure is now clear.

Specific performance bottlenecks were identified. SongLoader calls GetCurrentNote with O(n) complexity every frame. HitDetector scoring logic needs review. SUDPReceiver shares string fields across threads without locking. Thread.Abort is used, which is obsolete and dangerous. GetTuningState PERFECTO incorrectly uses Color.red. MidiToNoteName allocates a string array every frame. ExpectedNoteDisplay and PlayerNoteVisualizer update text every frame even when unchanged. TuningVisualizer repeatedly calls GetComponent and creates new Vector3 objects. Audience member tagging and duplicate StartSong calls were also noted.

HitDetector calls GetComponent twice per note every frame and AddScore during the entire evaluation window. NoteScroller calls GetComponent on every note each frame and instantiates all notes at startup. ControladorAudiencia queries tags once at start but reads "Calidad" float from each animator every frame. ControladorAudienciaSing recaches tag results every two seconds. EndGameManager polls audio time every frame instead of using clip events. PruneExpiredSamples in SingPublicSystem removes from the middle of a List, creating O(n²) cost.

Two lists are used where a single struct would be more efficient. isGameActive never becomes true because StartGame is never invoked from CantoMode. SingPublicSystem and ControladorAudienciaSing are absent from the SingGame scene. SUDPReceiver parses frequency, amplitude, and time values but discards them immediately. LyricsDisplay.cs.meta references a missing script. TessituraManager is also missing.

Notes should be sorted by start time and traversed with an index pointer rather than scanning the entire active list every frame. HitDetector processes every active note until it passes destroyX, so the workload grows without bound as the song continues. SpawnAllNotes instantiates the entire note pool at song start, meaning a 200-note song spawns hundreds of objects immediately. StartSong is invoked twice per song: SongLoader.LoadSongCoroutine calls it after loading finishes, and NoteScroller.Start calls it again after spawning notes.

The duplicate StartSong calls cause a behavior bug. Because audioSource.Play() restarts playback from the beginning, the song begins before notes spawn, then restarts again immediately after. This is a data flow issue that must be fixed to preserve existing behavior.
</details></think>

CantoMode is 17 C# files (plus two missing scripts still referenced in scenes). Live singing in `SingGame` uses **ControladorAudiencia**, not the newer Sing public system. The highest costs are per-frame scoring + logs, ~100 notes updated every frame, and ~100 audience animators.

---

## 1. Full file list

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Data/SongData.cs` | Serializable models: `SongNote`, `LyricLine`, `SongData` |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Data/SongLoader.cs` | Loads JSON + WAV from StreamingAssets, plays audio, tracks current expected note |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Networking/SUDPReceiver.cs` | Background UDP thread; parses `voice\|freq\|midi\|note\|cents\|amp\|time` |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/NoteScroller.cs` | Instantiates **all** notes at start; moves them every frame from audio time |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/ScrollingNote.cs` | Per-note data (`midi`, `startTime`, `duration` + unused flags) |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/HitDetector.cs` | Compares voice MIDI vs active notes; colors bars; scores every frame in a 70% window |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/ScoreManager.cs` | Running pitch/rhythm averages + integer score + TMP |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/PlayerNoteVisualizer.cs` | Moves a marker on Y from current MIDI; writes note name to TMP |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/ExpectedNoteDisplay.cs` | Writes expected note name to TMP every frame |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/TuningVisualizer.cs` | Moves cents indicator; recolors from string state (`PERFECTO`/`CASI`/else) |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/ControladorAudiencia.cs` | **Live** audience: `FindGameObjectsWithTag("Publico")` once, lerp Calidad + look-at + applause |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/ControladorAudienciaSing.cs` | Piano-style audience clone; **not on SingGame** |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/SingPublicSystem.cs` | Windowed public-score math cloned from piano; **not on SingGame**, `StartGame()` never called |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/EndGameManager.cs` | Polls clip end, shows UI, POSTs practice session |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/MenuPausa.cs` | XR menu button, `timeScale`, pause audio, restart/home |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Tessitura/AIServerFinder.cs` | Sequential HTTP scan of LAN `:5000/predict` |
| `Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Tessitura/TessituraData.cs` | DTO for tessitura JSON; **never used** |

**Missing `.cs` still referenced:**

- `LyricsDisplay.cs` — `.meta` exists; `SingGame.unity` still has the component. JSON lyrics are loaded but nothing displays them.
- `TessituraManager.cs` — `.meta` exists; `TessituraScene.unity` still has the component.

**On `SingGame.unity`:** HitDetector, ControladorAudiencia, PlayerNoteVisualizer, EndGameManager, LyricsDisplay (missing), SUDPReceiver, ScoreManager, ExpectedNoteDisplay, MenuPausa, SongLoader, TuningVisualizer, NoteScroller.

**Not on `SingGame`:** SingPublicSystem, ControladorAudienciaSing, AIServerFinder, TessituraData.

## 2. Performance issues

### Hot `Update()` work (Quest 3)

**HitDetector** — worst gameplay cost. Every frame it walks **every spawned note**, `GetComponent<ScrollingNote>()` + `GetComponent<Renderer>()`, then if the note is in the first 70% of its duration it scores, sets material color, and writes TMP:

```17:76:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/HitDetector.cs
    void Update()
    {
        // ...
        foreach (GameObject noteObj in scroller.GetActiveNotes())
        {
            ScrollingNote sn = noteObj.GetComponent<ScrollingNote>();
            // ...
            if (songTime >= noteStart && songTime <= evaluationEnd)
            {
                // AddScore / RegisterHit / RegisterRhythm every frame
                rend.material.color = Color.green; // also yellow/red
                ShowResult("Perfecto", Color.green);
            }
        }
    }
```

Songs have ~100 notes. All are instantiated at t=0 (`NoteScroller.SpawnAllNotes`), so this is ~100 × 2 `GetComponent` calls **every frame**, plus scoring for any currently overlapping notes.

**NoteScroller** — same list, `GetComponent<ScrollingNote>()` again, writes `transform.position` for every living note:

```28:56:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/NoteScroller.cs
    void Update()
    {
        // ...
        for (int i = activeNotes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            ScrollingNote sn = noteObj.GetComponent<ScrollingNote>();
            // compute X from songTime, assign position
            if (pos.x < destroyX) { Destroy(noteObj); activeNotes.RemoveAt(i); }
        }
    }
```

**ControladorAudiencia** — live audience path. `SingGame` has on the order of **~100 CityPeople prefabs** tagged `Publico`. Every frame: string `GetFloat("Calidad")` / `SetFloat("Calidad")`, `LookRotation` + `Slerp` **twice over the list** (rotation loop then animation loop).

**SongLoader.Update** — linear scan of the full `notes` array every frame:

```142:154:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Data/SongLoader.cs
    SongNote GetCurrentNote(float currentTime)
    {
        foreach (var note in loadedSong.notes)
        {
            if (currentTime >= note.start &&
                currentTime <= note.start + note.duration)
                return note;
        }
        return null;
    }
```

**SUDPReceiver.Update** — `Split`, `float.Parse` × 4, `int.Parse`, then **`Debug.Log` every packet**. Voice UDP is typically tens of Hz.

**TuningVisualizer / PlayerNoteVisualizer / ExpectedNoteDisplay** — TMP writes and/or `GetComponent<Renderer>` every frame even when values did not change.

**EndGameManager.Update** — cheap poll of `audioSource.time` vs `clip.length` until end (fine, but a callback is cleaner).

**MenuPausa.Update** — `InputDevices.GetDeviceAtXRNode` every frame (acceptable; cache the device).

### Allocations

| Location | What allocates |
|---|---|
| `SUDPReceiver` UDP thread | `new IPEndPoint`, `GetString`, `lastMessage` string every packet |
| `SUDPReceiver.Update` | `Split('|')`, Parse, interpolated `Debug.Log` |
| `ScoreManager.RegisterHit` | string concat `Debug.Log` **every hit sample** (every frame while a note is active) |
| `PlayerNoteVisualizer.MidiToNoteName` | **new `string[]` every call** + string concat |
| `ExpectedNoteDisplay` / `HitDetector.ShowResult` | TMP `.text` every frame |
| `TuningVisualizer` | `new Vector3`, `GetComponent<Renderer>`, `.material` (can instance a material) |
| `ControladorAudienciaSing.CacheAudienceAnimators` | `FindGameObjectsWithTag` every 2s + new wrapper objects |
| `NoteScroller` | `Instantiate` all notes up front; `Destroy` later (GC spikes) |
| `HitDetector` | `rend.material.color` can create a material instance per note |

### `FindObjectOfType` / `GetComponent` in `Update`

- **FindObjectOfType in Update:** `ControladorAudienciaSing.ResolveDependencies()` every frame (also `Camera.main`). Not in the live SingGame path unless that component is added.
- `SingPublicSystem.GetCurrentPerformance()` can `FindObjectOfType<ScoreManager>()`; dead because `isGameActive` stays false.
- **GetComponent in Update (live):** `HitDetector` (×2 per note), `NoteScroller` (×1 per note), `TuningVisualizer` (Renderer every frame).
- `EndGameManager.Start` uses `FindObjectOfType<AuthService>` once (OK).

### Debug.Log in hot paths

```42:44:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Gameplay/ScoreManager.cs
        Debug.Log(" RegisterHit llamado: " + value +
                  " | Total: " + totalEvaluations +
                  " | Accuracy: " + accuracyPercent);
```

Called from HitDetector **every frame per active note**. Combined with:

```91:91:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Networking/SUDPReceiver.cs
                Debug.Log($"Nota: {note} | {frequency} Hz | Cents: {cents:F2} | Estado: {tuningState}");
```

and ControladorAudiencia every 120 frames (`"Raw: " + raw + " | Puntaje: "`). On device this alone can tank the frame rate.

### String concat every frame

- ScoreManager log (above)
- SUDPReceiver interpolated log
- `PlayerNoteVisualizer`: `noteNames[i] + octave` every frame
- `ExpectedNoteDisplay`: assigns `note.note` or `""` every frame (TMP dirty)
- `TuningVisualizer`: string state `"PERFECTO"` / `"CASI"` compared every frame
- ControladorAudiencia: `GetFloat("Calidad")` **string hash** every NPC every frame (Sing version already uses `Animator.StringToHash`)

### Audience animators

Live path caches once in `Start` (good) but then drives **every NPC every frame** with string animator params and per-NPC `Slerp`.

`ControladorAudienciaSing` is worse if enabled: recache via `FindGameObjectsWithTag("Publico")` every 2 seconds, which **re-randomizes offsets** and allocates a new array.

`ProjectSettings/TagManager.asset` has `tags: []`. Prefabs still have `m_TagString: Publico`. `FindGameObjectsWithTag("Publico")` throws if the tag is not registered — audience may be a no-op or an exception at Start.

## 3. Unused methods / fields / classes

Searched across `Assets/Scripts`.

### Dead classes / scripts

| Item | Status |
|---|---|
| `TessituraData` | No references except its own file |
| `AIServerFinder.ServerURL` | Written, never read by any other script |
| `LyricLine` / `SongData.lyrics` / `songDuration` | Deserialized, never read in C# |
| `LyricsDisplay` | Missing script; scene still references it |
| `TessituraManager` | Missing script; TessituraScene still references it |
| `SingPublicSystem` | Not in SingGame; APIs never called from CantoMode |
| `ControladorAudienciaSing` | Not in SingGame; only constructed if SingPublicSystem runs |

### Unused public API on `SingPublicSystem`

`StartGame()`, `EndGame()`, `OnNoteHit()`, `OnNoteMiss()`, `GetCurrentPublicScore()`, `GetCurrentPublicScoreForApplause()` — **zero callers** in CantoMode. Piano equivalents are wired; singing is not.

`AudienceSyncTag` and `lastWindowAverage` are written and never read.

`isGameActive` stays `false` forever → `Update()` returns immediately. The whole system is inert.

### Unused fields on `ScrollingNote`

`totalTime`, `evaluated`, `alreadyScored`, `correctTime` — never read or written. `alreadyScored` looks like the intended guard against per-frame scoring.

### Unused parsed UDP fields

In `SUDPReceiver.Update`: `frequency`, `note`, `amplitude`, `time` are parsed and discarded.

### Unused private method

`SongLoader.GetCurrentNote` is used. `GetCurrentExpectedNote` is used by ExpectedNoteDisplay.

UI methods `ReiniciarCancion` / `IrMenuPrincipal` / `TogglePausa` / `VolverMenu` are public for buttons — keep them.

---

## 4. Duplicate audience systems

Three overlapping designs:

```
Piano (live, wired)
  PianoPublicSystem  →  ControladorAudienciaPiano
       │
       └── On Start: disables ControladorAudiencia on _GestorAudiencia

Canto (live in SingGame)
  ScoreManager.accuracyPercent  →  ControladorAudiencia
       └── applause AudioSource, difficulty from UserSession

Canto (dead clone of piano)
  SingPublicSystem  →  ControladorAudienciaSing
       └── StartGame/OnNoteHit never called; component not in scene
```

**ControladorAudiencia.cs** is the one on `_GestorAudiencia` in `SingGame.unity`. Piano still treats it as the legacy controller (`PianoPublicSystem.EnsureAudienceController` disables it; `MidiAudioManager` can steal its applause clip).

**ControladorAudienciaSing** is a near-copy of `ControladorAudienciaPiano` (hash, recache interval, look-at loop).

**SingPublicSystem** is a near-copy of `PianoPublicSystem` (window samples, pulses, curve, lerp) with comments documenting the copied tunings. HitDetector never calls `OnNoteHit`/`OnNoteMiss`.

**Recommendation:** keep one singing audience path. Either finish wiring SingPublicSystem + ControladorAudienciaSing (and disable ControladorAudiencia), or delete the unused pair and keep ControladorAudiencia. Do not run both.

---

## 6. Data flow (current vs optimal, same behavior)

### Current

```
SelectedSongManager.file_path
        │
        ▼
SongLoader.Start
  UnityWebRequest JSON → JsonUtility.FromJson<SongData>
  UnityWebRequest WAV  → AudioClip
  StartSong()  ──────────── audioSource.Play()     ◄── FIRST PLAY
        │
        ▼  (NoteScroller coroutine was spinning until loadedSong != null)
NoteScroller.SpawnAllNotes  → Instantiate ALL notes
  songLoader.StartSong()    → audioSource.Play()   ◄── RESTARTS AUDIO
        │
        ├─ NoteScroller.Update: move every note from audioSource.time
        ├─ SongLoader.Update: O(n) GetCurrentNote → ExpectedNoteDisplay TMP
        │
SUDPReceiver thread ──string──► Update parse ──► currentMidi / cents / state
        │
        ├─ PlayerNoteVisualizer (Y + TMP)
        ├─ TuningVisualizer (X + color)
        └─ HitDetector.Update
              for each active note:
                if in [start, start+0.7*duration]:
                  score EVERY FRAME → ScoreManager
        │
        ▼
ScoreManager.accuracyPercent
        │
        ▼
ControladorAudiencia.Update → animator Calidad + look-at + applause > 70
        │
        ▼
EndGameManager.Update: if time >= duration-0.1 → UI, Pause, POST session
```

**Behavioral bugs in this flow (not just perf):**

1. **Double `StartSong()`** — `Play()` restarts the clip after notes spawn.
2. **Per-frame scoring** — `alreadyScored` exists but is unused; a 0.35s note at 72 Hz can `AddScore(10)` ~18 times.
3. **SingPublicSystem never starts** — audience does not use hit pulses.
4. **Lyrics never shown** — LyricsDisplay script is gone.
5. **SUDPReceiver `PERFECTO` paints cents text red**, not green:

```105:109:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Networking/SUDPReceiver.cs
        if (absCents <= 5f)
        {
            ShowCents($"{cents}", Color.red);
            return "PERFECTO";
        }
```

### Suggested flow (same observable scoring/visuals, cheaper)

1. **Load:** one coroutine. When JSON+audio ready, spawn (or pool) notes, **then** `Play()` once. Fire `OnSongReady` / `OnSongStarted` instead of polling `loadedSong` and double-calling `StartSong`.
2. **Scroll:** keep a `List<ScrollingNote>` (or array). Spawn when `startX` enters view (`startTime - songTime < lookahead`). Recycle past `destroyX`. Cache `ScrollingNote` + `Transform` + `Renderer` on spawn. Drive X from `audioSource.time` only (already the source of truth).
3. **Expected note:** maintain a cursor index into sorted `notes` (notes are time-ordered). Advance when `songTime > note.end`. Do not rescan the array. Update TMP only when the note string changes.
4. **Voice:** background thread **only enqueues bytes** (`ConcurrentQueue<byte[]>` like `Core/Networking/UDPReceiver.cs`). Main thread dequeues, parses into a struct (`midi`, `cents`, `tuningEnum`). No strings, no logs.
5. **Hit detection:** iterate only notes whose window contains `songTime` (cursor / bucket). Cache components. **To preserve current scoring**, keep per-frame samples but stop allocating (no GetComponent, no Debug.Log, no TMP rewrite if message unchanged). Separately, `alreadyScored` is the correct design if you later want one verdict per note.
6. **Scoring:** `RegisterHit`/`RegisterRhythm` should be math only. TMP score text only when `score` changes.
7. **Audience:** one controller. Cache animators once. `Animator.StringToHash("Calidad")`. Throttle `SetFloat` (e.g. 10 Hz) and/or stagger NPCs. Look-at only nearby rows. Applause on threshold crossing only (`ManejarAudio` already does this).
8. **End:** `AudioSource.clip` length known at load — schedule end with `Invoke` / coroutine `WaitWhile(() => audioSource.isPlaying)` or `time >= duration - 0.1` at 5 Hz, not 72 Hz. Pause menu should also freeze hit evaluation (`if (pausado \|\| gameEnded) return`).

## 7. Threading / concurrency (`SUDPReceiver`)

```29:58:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Networking/SUDPReceiver.cs
    void Start()
    {
        receiveThread = new Thread(new ThreadStart(ReceiveData));
        receiveThread.IsBackground = true;
        receiveThread.Start();
    }

    void ReceiveData()
    {
        client = new UdpClient(port);
        while (true)
        {
            try
            {
                IPEndPoint anyIP = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, 0);
                byte[] data = client.Receive(ref anyIP);
                string text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(data);
                lastMessage = text;       // unsynchronized write
                messageReceived = true;   // unsynchronized write
            }
            catch { }
        }
    }
```

```138:144:Assets/Scripts/CantoMode/Networking/SUDPReceiver.cs
    void OnApplicationQuit()
    {
        if (receiveThread != null && receiveThread.IsAlive)
            receiveThread.Abort();
        if (client != null)
            client.Close();
    }
```

Problems vs Core `UDPReceiver` (which is the right pattern):

| Issue | Risk |
|---|---|
| `lastMessage` / `messageReceived` shared without `volatile` / lock / queue | Torn reads; dropped packets; rare crash |
| `while (true)` + empty `catch` | Swallows dispose/bind errors; thread never exits cleanly |
| `Thread.Abort()` | Deprecated, can corrupt `UdpClient`; can hang on Quest |
| No `OnDestroy` | Scene reload (restart song) leaks the thread + port |
| Port `12345` same as `UDPReceiver` | Bind failure if both exist |
| UTF-8 string on the worker | Extra alloc + encoding on the network thread |
| No `ReceiveTimeout` | `Receive` blocks forever; Abort is the only stop |

Core already does: `volatile keepRunning`, `ConcurrentQueue<byte[]>`, timeout, `Join(5000)`, no Abort.

## Refactor recommendations (by impact)

1. **Strip hot-path logs** — `ScoreManager.RegisterHit`, `SUDPReceiver` packet log, ControladorAudiencia 2s log. Largest FPS win, no behavior change.

2. **Fix UDP threading** — match Core `UDPReceiver`: byte queue, `keepRunning`, `OnDestroy`, no `Abort`. Prevents leaks on restart and Quest stalls.

3. **Cache note + renderer refs; stop GetComponent in Update** — HitDetector + NoteScroller. Same scoring, far less CPU.

4. **Stop instantiating all notes at t=0** — windowed spawn + pool. Cuts Update list size from ~100 to on-screen notes only.

5. **Audience: one system, hashed params, throttled SetFloat** — ~100 animators/look-ats per frame is the other Quest killer. Register `Publico` in TagManager or the cache is empty/throws.

6. **Delete or wire the dead Sing public clone** — `SingPublicSystem` + `ControladorAudienciaSing` currently do nothing. Either hook `OnNoteHit` from HitDetector and `StartGame` from SongLoader, or remove them so piano/canto do not drift further.

7. **TMP / string / material hygiene** — static note-name table, set text only on change, enum for tuning, MaterialPropertyBlock. Cheap but visible in Profiler.

8. **One `StartSong()` after notes exist** — avoids restarting the WAV; this *does* change timing vs today (today it restarts). Worth doing; document it.

9. **O(1) current-note cursor** — SongLoader + ExpectedNoteDisplay.

10. **Restore or remove missing scripts** — `LyricsDisplay` (lyrics are in JSON unused), `TessituraManager` (scene is broken). `TessituraData` + `AIServerFinder.ServerURL` are unused; finder scans 40 IPs with 1s timeout (~40s worst case) for a URL nobody reads.

11. **Comment/XML cleanup** — SingPublicSystem tuning diary and “Análogo a piano” docs after the duplicate is resolved.

12. **Scoring semantics (behavior change, call out separately)** — use `ScrollingNote.alreadyScored` so each note contributes once. Current per-frame `AddScore`/`RegisterHit` inflates score and accuracy. Do not mix this with a “no behavior change” perf pass.

**Do first on device:** (1) logs, (2) UDP queue, (3) cached note list, (5) audience throttle. Those are the Quest 3 frame-time problems. The duplicate public system is a maintainability problem, not a live CPU problem, because it never runs.
